verdict.rationale: Dover's own marketing documents AI applicant scoring that ranks applicants ("promotes the best people to the top"), and its Premium tier includes the feature, so the core AI screening and matching capability exists. The pack contains nothing on how the scoring works, what criteria it uses against the role, or what safeguards apply to automated decisions, such as human review, bias auditing, or candidate notice. That documentation half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: documentation of how AI scoring/matching works, documented safeguards for automated decisions (human-in-the-loop, bias audits, transparency/notice), independent or hands-on corroboration of scoring quality.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI helps screen and match candidates against the role — with the vendor documenting how it works and what safeguards apply to automated decisions
